body.x: U-HANPRESEN (CEO Shin Jung-sik, www.presenmarker.com) showcased its “PresenMarker”, which can draw lines on screens, in the joint pavilion of the Mobile Technology Convergence Center (MTCC) at the world’s best IT technology exhibition ‘CES(Consumer Technology Show) 2016’ which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas Convention Center(LVCC).
This is a solution that enables users to draw what they want on a screen by using the light from the product’s laser pointer. It can be operated with a mouse and save presentations as video files.

The product’s camera sensor detects a screen area and enables users to draw lines on a screen, detecting light from the laser pointer at 30fps. It matches the location of the detected laser pointer with a mouse in real time and synchronizes it with a computer. This enables users to control the laser pointer in real time with their mouse. If the product is installed inside a beam projector, the projector can be used like a smartphone.

U-HANPRESEN CEO Shin Jung-sik said: “The beam projector industry is a huge market worth 20 trillion won per year. We are expecting that our products with outstanding technology can be embedded in beam projectors at CES 2016.”

Since 1998, the company has been in the business for electronic teaching desks and blackboards and remote lecture systems. After five years of intense research, it successfully commercialized “PresenMarker”.

DIP prepared the joint pavilion at this exhibition and supported related domestic companies’ participation in CES 2016, promoting the reinforcement project for quality capability of the smart knowledge service, which is a promotional project for regional-specialized businesses supported by the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy. It is mainly focused on the competitiveness reinforcement business of new mobile convergence in the global market.

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), CES 2016 is the world's largest exhibition to see the latest global trends in electronics and IT industry in one spot.

AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES for 11 years to introduce the new technologies and products. After the local coverage and research, AVING News will hold ‘CES 2016 Review Conference’ in AVING Studio, Korea on January 28th.
